Ms. Clark (MA) moved to table the measure.
Considered as privileged matter. (consideration: CR H5218-5219; text: CR H5218)

QUESTION OF THE PRIVILEGES OF THE HOUSE - Ms. Greene (GA) rose to a question of the privileges of the House and offered the resolution. The Chair directed the Clerk to report the resolution. Upon examination of the resolution, the Chair determined that the resolution did constitute a question of the privileges of the House.
